learning.title: Committing in the task worktree while a reviewer runs makes its record unusable
learning.trigger: The orchestrator commits task.md, a plan successor or any file in the task worktree after assigning a slice or plan reviewer and before the reviewer's record is published.
learning.mistake: A review record binds reviewed_commit to HEAD and revision to contract.mjs revision, and phase-complete requires the reviewed commit to equal HEAD. A task.md or plan edit changes the revision and a commit moves HEAD, so the record cannot complete its phase.
learning.rule: Do no commit and no task.md or plan edit in the task worktree between assigning a reviewer and running phase-complete on its published record. Record decisions in scratch and apply them after phase-complete. If it happened, reset only the local unpushed commit back to the reviewed commit, confirm HEAD and the revision equal the record's values, and wait.

verification.requirement: `git rev-parse HEAD` and `node contract.mjs revision <task-dir>` equal the record's reviewed_commit and revision when phase-complete runs.
